q: Pesin's entropy formula relates KS entropy to Lyapunov exponents for a C² diffeomorphism preserving a smooth measure μ:
opts: h_μ(f) = ∑_{λᵢ>0} λᵢ (sum of positive Lyapunov exponents)
h_μ(f) = ∫ λ₁(x) dμ(x) where λ₁ is the top Lyapunov exponent
exp: Pesin (1977): h_μ(f) = ∫∑_{λᵢ>0}λᵢ(x)dμ(x) for smooth invariant measures. The KS entropy equals the total expansion rate (sum of positive Lyapunov exponents). For general invariant measures, only the inequality ≤ holds (Ruelle).
